description: Fixed constraints baked into the M365 relay OBO image: the default Graph scope list (operators override it with MS365_MCP_ALLOWED_SCOPES; Softeria's --allowed-scopes derives the tool surface from the scopes at every start), the tools excluded because the relay provides a better replacement (download-bytes* → get-download-url), the attachment primitives hidden because Softeria's get-upload-url replaces them (graph-batch stays registered for the gate's own read-mail-text), and the safety switches (not weakenable through the environment). Nothing is withheld for any other reason: what an organisation does not want is Blocked in Claude's per-tool permissions.
